455-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
455-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama (and up to two other target creatures) to their owners' hands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-3899-5011.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1580-4556-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

443-1263-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4644-4667-7791.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.

1362-1479-1659.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Seed the Land and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2421-3705-5231-7057.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
413-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

3661-5220-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3525-4324-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-4324-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-4324-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

252-2073-2099--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

813-2104-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Siren's Ruse.
813-2104-2417.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1495-2060-5231-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-5231-5544-6431.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

3693-3967-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Yahenni has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Yahenni deathtouch.
3693-3967-4613.description:
Give Yahenni deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Yahenni using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Yahenni's deathtouch.
Yahenni triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
If you can give Yahenni deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1323-3129-4762.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-3129-4762.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

478-2092-2645-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
Candelabra of Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
478-2092-2645-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Candelabra of Tawnos to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by tapping it and paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping the up to six lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

796-2440-2871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Zombies.
796-2440-2871-5231.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

643-718-3809-4508.description:
Activate Kumano by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1329-1379-3693-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1379-3693-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Walking Ballista from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

224-872-1525-1637.notablePrerequisites:
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
224-872-1525-1637.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2988-4435-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2988-4435-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

512-3990-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Halo Fountain and Incubation Druid do not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Ensoul Artifact attached to Halo Fountain.
512-3990-4832.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping it and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

487-2034-3902.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
487-2034-3902.description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible by any method.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and create a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 4.

91-2060-3944-5112.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-2060-3944-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1980-3803-4131-5261.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream's Grip without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Dream's Grip, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Dream's Grips, untapping Isochron Scepter and Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

3129-3423-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasure tokens.
3129-3423-4541.description:
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-2608-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
1409-2608-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi's soulbond ability by paying {1}{U}, exiling Derevi and returning it to the battlefield.
Deadeye Navigator and Derevi trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye navigator trigger, pairing Deadeye Navigator with Derevi.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

2226-3727.description:
Tap Karakas targeting Zacama to return Zacama to your hand.
Tap your lands for at least {7}{W}{R}{G} Cast Zacama.
Zacama enters the battlefield, untapping all your lands.
Repeat.

1385-4050-4350-5189.notablePrerequisites: Butcher Ghoul does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1385-4050-4350-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {1}.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul undying trigger, returning Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Butcher Ghoul, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
